items.reason: Gap 1 explicitly describes two overlapping retries both passing the in-memory check and running the handler before either inserts the event ID.
Gap 2 describes supplying an X-Event-Id value that differs from the ID in the signed body, identifying that the header can be changed independently of signed content.
Gap 0 states that the provider sends charge.refunded while the handlers only register refund.created, leaving the refund unhandled.
None of the gaps depends on multiple processes, instances, or replicas.
